channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-128238 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Scapy before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the BER/ASN.1 decoder in scapy/asn1/ber.py that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash parsing applications. Attackers can send a single 833-byte packet with 250 nested ASN.1 SEQUENCE structures to trigger an unhandled RecursionError, terminating TLS, SNMP, X.509, or LDAP parsers even with safe=True.

item.title: CVE-2026-128239 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Form spatial-constraint handlers in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c that lets attackers crash the process via unchecked group lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose Form constraints reference a non-existent group, crashing tools like MP4Box during chapter import for denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-128240 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c because gf_sg_reset() frees unregistered prototypes still referenced by scene commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene declaring prototypes via commands, processed by MP4Box -chap, to trigger freed memory access and crash the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-128241 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.1
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.1 | The xmlwf tool in libexpat through 2.10.0 contains a symlink following vulnerability because -d output mode opens files with fopen("wb"), which follows symbolic links. Local attackers with write access to the output directory can plant a symlink at the expected output name to truncate or overwrite files writable by the xmlwf user.

item.title: CVE-2026-128242 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | actix-http before 3.20.1 and actix-web before 4.18.2 contain an unbounded decompression vulnerability in encoding::Decoder that lets remote attackers exhaust memory and CPU via compressed bodies. Attackers can send small highly compressed gzip, deflate, Brotli or zstd request bodies to Json, Form, Bytes or String extractors, or serve them to awc clients, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-128328 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to list tracked files of any git repository by supplying an arbitrary repoPath to patch.readRepoDirectories. Attackers with read access to one service can enumerate file and directory names of other tenants' application and compose source trees on the host or managed servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-128329 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to read arbitrary files by supplying ../ sequences in the filePath of patch.readRepoFile. Attackers with service read permission can read /etc/shadow, SSH private keys, and secret environment files on the Dokploy host or managed remote servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-128330 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because password changes do not revoke existing web sessions. Attackers holding a leaked password or copied session cookie keep access for up to 30 days, reading integration credentials, creating API keys, or registering passkeys.

item.title: CVE-2026-128331 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an unverified password change vulnerability that allows holders of a signed-in session to change the account password without supplying the current password. Attackers with a stolen session cookie or unattended device can submit new password fields via updateSettings to lock out the owner and take over the account.

item.title: CVE-2026-128332 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | Listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a 2FA bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to brute-force TOTP codes because the attempt counter resets on every new password login. Attackers can repeatedly submit credentials to POST /admin/login to obtain fresh tokens, each allowing 15 more guesses, gaining sessions for 2FA-protected accounts including Super Admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-128333 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in doResetPassword that skips TOTP verification after a password reset. Attackers who can complete a reset, such as by reading the victim's reset email, obtain fully authenticated sessions including Super Admin without the TOTP code.

item.title: CVE-2026-128334 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | listmonk 6.2.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit Azure Event Grid bounce webhooks when no shared secret is configured. Attackers can POST forged EmailDeliveryReportReceived events with Bounced status to /webhooks/service/azure to blocklist, unsubscribe, or delete arbitrary subscribers.

item.title: CVE-2026-128335 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | Contao 4.6.0 before 5.3.54, 5.4.0-RC1 before 5.7.17, and 6.0.0-RC1 before 6.0.6 fails to invalidate existing user sessions when two-factor authentication is enabled or disabled. Because Contao\User::isEqualTo() and serialized session data omit two-factor state, attackers already holding a session keep it after the owner changes 2FA settings.

item.title: CVE-2026-128336 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows attackers to add numeric keys to Object.prototype through a crafted defined name referencing a __proto__ sheet. Attackers can supply an xlsx whose xl/workbook.xml definedName range targets __proto__, causing CellMatrix to write empty arrays onto Object.prototype process-wide when workbook.xlsx.load() runs.

item.title: CVE-2026-128337 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in mergeConditionalFormattings that allows attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying an x14:cfRule id of __proto__. Attackers can craft an xlsx file that, when loaded with xlsx.load(), sets properties such as type, direction, border and cfvo on every object in the process until it restarts.

item.title: CVE-2026-128338 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a worksheet col element with an unbounded max attribute. Attackers can craft a small workbook with a huge max value, causing xlsx.load() to allocate hundreds of millions of Column objects and abort the process with an uncatchable heap out-of-memory error.

item.title: CVE-2026-128339 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in Worksheet._parseMergeCells that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying unbounded mergeCell ranges. Attackers can craft a small workbook with a mergeCell ref like A1:XFD1048576, causing xlsx.load() to create billions of Row and Cell objects and abort the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-128340 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an oversized defined-name range. DefinedNames.addEx expands ranges such as S!$A$1:$XFD$1048576 from xl/workbook.xml cell by cell, causing an uncatchable fatal heap out-of-memory error during xlsx.load().

item.title: CVE-2026-128341 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in data-validations-xform.js that allows attackers to exhaust CPU and memory by supplying unbounded sqref ranges. Attackers can provide a small crafted workbook with a sqref of A1:XFD1048576 to make xlsx.load() iterate billions of addresses, blocking the event loop and crashing the process with an uncatchable out-of-memory error.

item.title: CVE-2026-128342 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying an unbounded sheetId in xl/workbook.xml. Attackers can provide a workbook with a huge sheetId, making the sparse worksheet array walk stall worksheets, getWorksheet and writeBuffer for seconds.

item.title: CVE-2026-128343 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying unbounded row r attributes parsed in row-xform.js. Attackers can craft an XLSX file with a row numbered far beyond Excel's limit, making getSheetValues(), workbook writes and CSV export consume time proportional to that number.

item.title: CVE-2026-128344 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an unbounded image anchor column in the drawing part. Attackers can set an anchor column such as 300000000 in xl/drawings/drawing1.xml so reading getImages() anchor positions makes Worksheet.getColumn allocate millions of Column objects and abort with a heap out-of-memory error.

item.title: CVE-2026-128345 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in slideFormula in lib/utils/shared-formula.js when translating shared formulas to child cells. Attackers can supply a crafted spreadsheet with very long master formulas, such as runs of hyphens, causing quadratic regex backtracking that blocks the Node.js event loop.

item.title: CVE-2026-128346 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource leak vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookReader.parse that leaves temporary files and open descriptors when sheet parsing fails or iteration stops early. Attackers can repeatedly upload malformed multi-sheet workbooks with worksheets placed before xl/sharedStrings.xml to fill the temporary directory and exhaust file descriptors.

item.title: CVE-2026-128347 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookWriter that allows attackers to read local files by supplying crafted image filenames to addImage. Attackers can inject ../ path segments into user-controlled image paths, causing addMedia to embed any file readable by the Node.js process under xl/media in the generated workbook.

item.title: CVE-2026-128348 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a formula injection vulnerability in the totals row formula getter in lib/doc/table.js that fails to escape [, ], # and ' characters in structured reference column names. Attackers can supply column names containing ] via untrusted input like imported CSV headers to inject formulas such as HYPERLINK that exfiltrate cell values when users open and click the generated workbook.

item.title: CVE-2026-61417 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Dell SmartFabric OS10 Software, versions prior to 10.6.0.10, contains an Improper Access Control vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-61418 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | Dell SmartFabric OS10 Software, versions prior to 10.6.0.10, contains an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-75487 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root via the WireGuard server private_key option. Attackers can save a private key containing $() command substitution, which runs when action_wireguards_export() passes it to luci.sys.exec during configuration export.

item.title: CVE-2026-75488 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the CWMP client that allows a malicious ACS to corrupt stack memory via oversized credentials. Attackers controlling the ACS can send Username and Password values up to 256 bytes in TR-069 Download or Upload requests, overflowing 128-byte stack buffers and crashing the CWMP process.

item.title: CVE-2026-75489 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.1
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.1 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an insufficient verification of data authenticity vulnerability in the mt_wifi Smart Mesh Technology (SMT) onboarding, which protects messages only with an AES-CBC key derived from public values and a CRC32 check. Adjacent unauthenticated attackers can forge SMT messages in Probe Request vendor IEs carrying an attacker-chosen SSID and pre-shared key, forcing unpaired devices to join attacker-controlled access points.

item.title: CVE-2026-75490 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to run root commands by advertising a rogue automesh controller over mDNS. Attackers on the upstream Ethernet segment can advertise _cudycmagent._tcp records pointing to a malicious MQTT broker, then send commands encrypted with a fixed AES key that router/batchcmd.lua executes as root.

item.title: CVE-2026-75491 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Mosquitto plugin auth_plugin_jwt.so that accepts unsigned JWTs using alg none. Attackers holding any Cudy-trusted client certificate can authenticate as admincudydevice on port 8883 and publish batchcmd requests to execute commands as root.

item.title: CVE-2026-75492 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an unauthenticated stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the stun_client TR-111 UDP Connection Request parser that parses requests before verifying username or HMAC. Remote attackers can send a single crafted UDP datagram lacking a space in the request line, causing strncpy() to overflow a 10-byte stack buffer and crash stun_client for denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-75493 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in an obuspa getter for the TR-098 WLANConfiguration KeyPassphrase parameter, which copies the stored value with strcpy() into a 4,096-byte stack buffer without a length check. A malicious or compromised ACS can set a 5,000-byte passphrase via SetParameterValues, and a later read of the parameter overflows the buffer and crashes obuspa, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-75494 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows a malicious or compromised ACS to inject curl options through unfiltered Username and Password values in the easycwmpd Upload handler. Attackers can embed whitespace to add options like -o and --url to the root-run curl command, writing attacker-controlled HTTP responses to arbitrary files on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-75495 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a malicious or compromised ACS to execute commands as root by supplying a crafted InternetGatewayDevice.User.{i}.Password value. Attackers can send a SetParameterValues request with shell metacharacters that obuspa_system.lua concatenates into a luci.util.exec() command string, gaining root command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-75576 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root via an unvalidated multipart filename in the CBI FileUpload handler. Attackers can upload a valid OpenVPN configuration file through the VPN client config page with a filename containing $() shell substitution, which is passed through Lua %q to /bin/sh -c.

item.title: CVE-2026-75577 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by storing a malicious WireGuard private key. Attackers can save a private_key containing $() shell substitution and call the vpn.export_conf method on the /cgi-bin/luci/rpc/app JSON-RPC endpoint, which passes the key to a wg pubkey shell command.

item.title: CVE-2026-75578 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Friday 13 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability in luci/model/cbi/vpn/openvpn/client.lua, which embeds the shellquote()-quoted remote host token of an uploaded OpenVPN configuration inside an already single-quoted sed program run by os.execute(), so the nested quotes terminate the outer quote. Authenticated administrators can upload an .ovpn file whose remote host token contains a semicolon to execute arbitrary commands as root.
